contracts.ep.inj_data: SU-quarter ownership (hgi-takeover 2026-10-09, defined by the die-integration owner): inject flit i (inj_idx, broadcast to all four quarters on t_su_q[546:580]) is owned by quarter i mod 4 in the order SW, NW, SE, NE; the owner drives its 1024-bit f_su_q (hfd_su t_coll), the other three drive 0, so the OR is the owner data. The functional SU inject gate is one AND per quarter (the physical envelope hfd_su has no inject select); hfd_coll rtl_hgi asserts at most one non-zero quarter.
